newsitem.title: SLOVENIA: Slovenia's Bohor to list on Ljubljana OTC.
newsitem.headline: Slovenia's Bohor to list on Ljubljana OTC.

text.p: Slovenian saw-mill company Bohor will list its shares on the over-the-counter (OTC) section of the Ljubljana bourse on June 18, the Ljubljana Stock Exchange said on Tuesday.
The company will list 159,886 ordinary shares, with a nominal value of 1,000 tolars each ($6.39), representing 60.8 percent of its total equity.
Bohor is the 30th company to be listed on the main or OTC sections of the Ljubljana bourse since the beginning of last year.
Currently there are 28 issues traded on the main and 40 on the OTC market. -- Novica Mihajlovic, Ljubljana neewsroom, 386-61-125-8439
